paper_source.citation: Azizov, Vela-Tambo, Guo, Transpilation-Aware Runtime Prediction for Noisy Quantum Circuit Simulation, arXiv:2609.12980
paper_source.implementation_status: author code and raw runtime table were unavailable to this project

paper_design_reconstructed.target: Qiskit Aer noisy-simulator execution time after transpilation at fixed shots; transpilation time is separate

representations.source_gnn: source DAG plus 41 source global features: the paper's 36 Ma–Li-derived features and five SupermarQ metrics
representations.hybrid_gnn: source DAG plus 54 globals: the 41 source globals and 13 post-transpilation globals
representations.transpiled_gnn: transpiled DAG plus 41 globals computed from the transpiled circuit

paper_design_reconstructed.architecture: three TransformerConv graph layers, global mean pooling, two-layer global-feature MLP, concatenation and regression head

local_cell.frontier_q10_q16: 42 members are coverage/scaling only; no frontier accuracy or extrapolation claim in this protocol

representation_contract.common_identity: exact_qasm_sha256; duplicate aliases must share a fold and cannot be split between train and test
representation_contract.transpilation: Each source circuit is transpiled deterministically under the frozen local Aer context. Store input-QASM hash, transpiled-QASM hash, target/noise hashes, Qiskit/Aer versions, optimization level and seed.
representation_contract.feature_dictionary_gate: Before any model fit, emit a versioned feature dictionary that names all 36 Ma–Li-derived fields, five SupermarQ fields, and 13 post-transpilation fields; record extractor code hash and a per-feature missing/constant audit. Do not replace unknown paper fields with unnamed proxies.
representation_contract.source_gnn: source DAG and audited 41 source globals
representation_contract.hybrid_gnn: the same source DAG and audited 54 source-plus-transpilation globals
representation_contract.transpiled_gnn: transpiled DAG and audited 41 transpiled globals
representation_contract.dag_size_policy: Record every DAG node/edge count. A resource cap, if needed, must be fixed before training, retain excluded rows as unavailable, and apply identically to the controlled three-representation comparison.

split_and_fit.outer_split: The frozen five-fold assignment keyed by exact QASM hash from the local Aer core evidence. Duplicate aliases share the same fold.
split_and_fit.inner_selection: Any normalization, zero-variance removal and hyperparameter choice is fit inside outer-train only. If a paper-like 80/20 split is additionally reported, it is a separate diagnostic and cannot replace the five-fold common-panel table.
split_and_fit.target_transform: log1p(seconds) for fitting; expm1 for reported seconds
split_and_fit.seed_reduction: rowwise median prediction; retain each seed prediction and seed dispersion
split_and_fit.classical_baselines: Run the five paper-named baselines on the corresponding audited global vector. Fixed-thread CPU execution is allowed for these baselines only.
split_and_fit.neural_compute: CUDA is mandatory. Record framework/CUDA/driver/GPU/precision/memory and a CUDA smoke test before fold 0.
no_selection_rules: no source/back-end label used as an undeclared predictor

execution_order: C-A1: materialize the 162-member core manifest and audit exact-hash/fold join
C-A2: materialize all three representations and feature dictionaries; run static leakage, shape and constant-feature tests
S-A1: strong review of materialization against this contract and paper feature counts
C-A3: CUDA smoke test plus fold 0 for all neural representations and corresponding classical baselines
S-A2: validate fold-0 terminal accounting, train-only preprocessing, OOF IDs and GPU evidence
C-A4: execute folds 1–4, aggregate exact shared-row metrics, source/hybrid/transpiled controlled comparison and terminal coverage
fold_0_acceptance: every assigned fold-0 hash has exactly one terminal state per representation and seed
feature dictionary counts are 41/54/41 before train-only zero-variance removal; removed fields are logged per fold
all three neural runs prove CUDA execution and preserve all three seed outputs
no exact hash or alias appears in both train and test
raw timing measurements are read-only inputs and no GPU timing worker ran concurrently
reader_claim: If all gates pass, this is an independent local reimplementation on the frozen 162-member noisy-Aer core. It is not a numerical replication of Azizov's 1,402-circuit, two-backend, four-optimization-level HPC dataset.
